title: Read-path robustness follow-ups (errors, scheduling filter, null-tolerance)
description: Deferred MEDIUM/LOW findings from the TASK-002 code review. None block the read path working, but each is a deliberate decision worth making before the read API is widely consumed. Bundle them into one hardening pass.
acceptance_criteria: Decide and implement consumer-facing error handling for getPostList/getPostBySlug: either normalize @sanity/client rejections into a typed error shape, or explicitly document that raw SDK errors surface (project-context.md says consumer-facing error shapes are part of the contract).

Decide the scheduling policy for POST_BY_SLUG_QUERY: currently a future-dated post hidden from the list is still directly reachable by slug. Either add `&& defined(publishedAt) && publishedAt <= now()` to the detail filter for airtight scheduling, or document the asymmetry as intentional (e.g. for preview-by-slug).

Make body/optional fields null-tolerant: detail query projects `body[]` which yields null (not []) when absent; either coalesce to [] in GROQ or widen the `Post.body` type. Confirm the TASK-003 renderer guards either way.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: Created from read-client-reviewer findings on TASK-002. The wordCount->bodyCharCount misnomer (also a review finding) was fixed in TASK-002 itself because it is public API (semver-major if deferred); these three are safe to defer.

closure.summary: Read-path hardening done (tests-first). AC1: BlogReadError (+ isBlogReadError, BlogReadOperation) normalizes client.fetch rejections in getPostList/getPostBySlug, preserving original as cause (Error options + own prop, setPrototypeOf for instanceof); a no-match null is NOT wrapped. AC2: POST_BY_SLUG_QUERY now airtight (defined(publishedAt) && publishedAt <= now()); POST_BY_SLUG_PREVIEW_QUERY unfiltered escape hatch; getPostBySlug(client, slug, {allowUnpublished?}) selects (default false=airtight). Both detail queries share DETAIL_PROJECTION. AC3: body coalesced to [] in GROQ so Post.body is always a non-null array; BlogPostPreview already renders [] safely (confirmed). New exports are additive (semver-minor); the one behavioral change (by-slug no longer reaches scheduled posts unless allowUnpublished) recorded in CHANGELOG + README. 117/117 tests, typecheck + typecheck:test + lint + build all green. Independent reviewer PASS, no HIGH/MEDIUM.
